Sadie slept 8 hours on Monday.  
On Tuesday and Wednesday, she slept 2 hours less than Monday each day: 8 - 2 = 6 hours per day.  
The rest of the week (Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday) she slept 1 hour more than those two days: 6 + 1 = 7 hours per day.  

Total sleep for the week:  
Monday: 8  
Tuesday: 6  
Wednesday: 6  
Thursday: 7  
Friday: 7  
Saturday: 7  
Sunday: 7  

Sum = 8 + 6 + 6 + 7 + 7 + 7 + 7 = 48 hours.

Answer: 48
